title_en: Lianyungang City Ganyu District Environmental Protection Association v. Wang Shengjie — public interest litigation for environmental pollution damage compensation
ruling_gist_en: The party that causes environmental pollution damage shall be liable to eliminate the damage. Where an actor illegally discharges industrial waste acid into a river without permission, causing environmental pollution, the actor shall bear the responsibility of remediating the polluted environment to eliminate the harm already caused. To achieve the ultimate goal of restoring the polluted environment in the most scientific and reasonable manner, the court may adopt the method of expert witnesses presenting arguments in court to provide professional technical support. When the actor's economic compensation capacity is insufficient, the remediation costs may be determined by reference to the current national average daily wage standard of workers. In accordance with the environmental legislative principle of "who pollutes, who treats; who harms, who compensates," the actor is required to offset the damage caused to the environment by providing labor activities beneficial to environmental protection.

full_text_en:
Ganyu District Environmental Protection Association of Lianyungang City v. Wang Shengjie — public interest litigation for compensation for environmental pollution damage

Ruling Summary

A person who causes environmental pollution hazard has the responsibility to eliminate the hazard. Where an actor, without permission, illegally discharges industrial waste acid into a river, causing environmental pollution, he shall bear the responsibility to restore the polluted environment so as to eliminate the harm already caused. In order to achieve the ultimate goal of restoring the polluted environment in the most scientific and reasonable manner, the court may adopt the method of expert witness testimony in court to provide professional technical support. Where the actor's financial compensation capacity is insufficient, the restoration costs may be determined with reference to the current national average daily wage standard for workers. In accordance with the environmental legislative principle of "whoever pollutes shall treat, whoever damages shall compensate," the actor may be required to offset the environmental damage he has caused by providing labor services beneficial to environmental protection.

Plaintiff: Ganyu District Environmental Protection Association of Lianyungang City, domiciled at: No. [address], Qingkou Town New City Qindao Road, Ganyu District, Lianyungang City.
Legal Representative: Xu Changping, President of the Association.
Procuratorial Authority Supporting the Action: Lianyungang City People's Procuratorate, domiciled at: No. [address], Chaoyang East Road, Xinpu District, Lianyungang City.
Legal Representative: Wang Yue, Chief Procurator of the Procuratorate.
Defendant: Wang Shengjie, male, 43 years old, Han nationality, residing in Ganyu District, Lianyungang City.

The plaintiff, Ganyu District Environmental Protection Association of Lianyungang City (hereinafter referred to as the Ganyu Environmental Protection Association), filed a public interest litigation against the defendant, Wang Shengjie, for compensation for environmental pollution damage before the Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province.

Plaintiff's Allegations: Since the second half of 2012, the defendant, Wang Shengjie, at his quartz stone processing plant in Shiling Village, Shiqiao Town, Ganyu District, Lianyungang City, used hydrochloric acid in pickling tanks to clean quartz stones. He discharged the acid-containing wastewater generated during the pickling process through seepage pits into the Longbei Main Canal in Ganyu District, Lianyungang City, causing pollution to the Longbei Main Canal and the associated Lugou River. Wang Shengjie discharged over 100 tons of acid-containing wastewater, causing river pollution, damaging the environment, and harming the public interest. He should compensate for the costs of river remediation. The plaintiff requested that the court order Wang Shengjie to pay compensation of RMB 109,000 for the environmental losses caused by the discharge of acid-containing wastewater and to bear the plaintiff's reasonable expenses of RMB 3,500 incurred in connection with this litigation.

Supporting Opinion of the Lianyungang City People's Procuratorate: The defendant, Wang Shengjie, illegally set up pipelines and seepage pits to discharge acid-containing wastewater, causing river pollution. Pursuant to Article 41 of the Environmental Protection Law of the People's Republic of China, a person who causes environmental pollution hazard has the responsibility to eliminate the hazard and compensate the units or individuals directly suffering damage. Article 15 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides that state organs, social organizations, enterprises, and institutions may support the damaged units or individuals to bring a lawsuit in the People's Court in respect of acts infringing upon the civil rights and interests of the State, a collective, or an individual. We hereby support the Ganyu District Environmental Protection Association of Lianyungang City in initiating this environmental public interest litigation, to timely recover the relevant compensation costs and remediate the polluted river.

Defendant's Defense: The fact of the environmental pollution is true. I am willing to compensate for the losses caused by the environmental damage and will actively cooperate with the court to compensate the injured party to the best of my ability. If I truly do not have enough money to pay, I am willing to perform some public welfare work to make up for the damage I have caused. I deeply regret the environmental damage I have caused and will definitely do more things beneficial to the environment in the future.

To support its claims, the plaintiff, Ganyu Environmental Protection Association, submitted the following evidence to the Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province:

*First Set of Evidence:*
The social organization registration certificate of the plaintiff, Ganyu Environmental Protection Association, proving that the plaintiff is a social organization engaged in environmental public welfare undertakings and has the standing to initiate a public interest litigation.

*Second Set of Evidence:*
Evidence 1: Six interrogation records of the defendant, Wang Shengjie, from the former Ganyu County Public Security Bureau.
Evidence 2: Six monitoring reports from the former Ganyu County Environmental Monitoring Station, proving that the sewage at the defendant Wang Shengjie's drainage outlet and the Longbei Main Canal, as well as the polluted river water, had seriously exceeded the standards for pH value and fluoride, with the highest pH value exceeding the standard by 4.38 times and the highest fluoride exceeding the standard by 45.8 times.
Evidence 3: An official letter from the Department of Environmental Protection of Jiangsu Province, proving that the monitoring data of the former Ganyu County Environmental Monitoring Station was recognized by the provincial department and met evidentiary requirements.
Evidence 4: A record of on-site inspection and examination by the Criminal Police Brigade of the former Ganyu County Public Security Bureau, confirming the scene of the defendant Wang Shengjie's pollution discharge and the polluted river channel.

*Third Set of Evidence:*
Evidence 1: An assessment report from the Lianyungang City Environmental Science Research Institute, proving that the pollution remediation cost for the river channel polluted by the defendant Wang Shengjie is RMB 109,000.
Evidence 2: An invoice for agency fees, proving that the plaintiff, Ganyu Environmental Protection Association, incurred lawyer fees of RMB 3,500 for initiating this public interest litigation.

After in-court cross-examination, the defendant, Wang Shengjie, raised no objection to the authenticity, legality, or relevance to the case of the evidence submitted by the plaintiff, Ganyu Environmental Protection Association.

The defendant, Wang Shengjie, did not submit any evidence to the Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province.

During the trial of this case, the Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province, lawfully investigated Yin Xiangren, the village branch secretary of Shigongqi Village, Shiqiao Town, Ganyu District. Yin Xiangren testified that the quartz stone processing plant of the defendant, Wang Shengjie, had ceased production and was no longer operating. Wang Shengjie's family financial situation was poor, and he still owed many debts.

After in-court cross-examination, the plaintiff, Ganyu Environmental Protection Association, and the defendant, Wang Shengjie, raised no objection to the authenticity or legality of the evidence collected by the Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province.

During the court proceedings, the expert appraiser, Cui Huiping, a researcher from the Lianyungang City Environmental Science Research Institute, appeared in court to accept cross-examination by both parties regarding the expert appraisal report issued by the Institute. The appraiser opined that, for the situation of the defendant Wang Shengjie discharging acid-containing wastewater, the main method for treating acid-containing wastewater is neutralization with alkali. Considering the need to avoid secondary pollution, based on the chemical equation for the neutralization reaction of soda ash and hydrochloric acid, theoretically, treating 1 ton of wastewater containing 5% acid requires 0.145 tons of soda ash. Treating 100 tons of acid-containing wastewater would require 14.5 tons of soda ash, with the pollution treatment cost being approximately RMB 21,800. The Regulations on the Prevention and Control of Water Pollution in the Tongyu River of Jiangsu Province stipulate that the water quality of the Tongyu River and its main water supply channels shall comply with Class III standards of the national surface water environmental quality standards. The Longbei Main Canal is part of the northward extension water diversion project of the Tongyu River, and its environmental function zone type is Class III. According to the recommended method for calculating the amount of environmental pollution damage in the *Several Opinions on Carrying out the Work of Environmental Pollution Damage Identification and Assessment* (Huan Fa [2011] No. 60) issued by the Ministry of Environmental Protection of the State, the remediation cost for water pollution in a Class III river should be 4.5 to 6 times the virtual treatment cost. Taking 5 times as the calculation basis, the pollution remediation cost is RMB 109,000.

The Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province, invited Liu Weijing, Director and Researcher-Level Senior Engineer of the Jiangsu Provincial Environmental Engineering Consulting Center, to appear in court as an expert witness to evaluate the scientific validity of the expert appraisal report on the pollution damage caused by the defendant, Wang Shengjie. The appearing expert witness opined that the amount in the appraisal report was relatively consistent with the objective facts of this case. However, this case involved two pollution indicators for the acid wastewater: first, the pH value, and second, the exceedance of fluoride. The appraisal report's use of soda ash neutralization could only address the pH value exceedance, not the fluoride pollution. It was suggested to use calcium hydroxide for treatment, which would also lower the treatment cost. Considering the cost of acid regulation and transportation of the wastewater, the comprehensive total treatment cost for 100 tons of acidic wastewater was approximately RMB 14,616.7. According to the *Several Opinions on Carrying out the Work of Environmental Pollution Damage Identification and Assessment* issued by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, using the multiple of the virtual treatment cost method, the pollution remediation cost for 100 tons of acid-containing wastewater was approximately RMB 75,000.

The appearing appraiser and expert witness conducted expert arguments in court on matters such as the environmental remediation costs. Both parties agreed that, for surface water pollution, the remediation cost should be calculated with reference to 4.5 to 6 times the virtual treatment cost. Regarding the virtual treatment cost, the appraiser stated that the assessment report used soda ash treatment because of the potential impact of limewater on the temperature difference of the river. When issuing the assessment report, the fluoride situation was not considered. The appraiser accepted the calculation result for the virtual cost provided by the appearing expert witness.

After cross-examination, the plaintiff, Ganyu Environmental Protection Association, and the defendant, Wang Shengjie, both considered the opinion of the appearing expert witness on the pollution treatment and remediation costs to be more scientific and reasonable.

Facts Found by the Court (First Instance):

The evidence undisputed by both parties is confirmed. Regarding the treatment cost for the environmental pollution damage caused by the defendant, Wang Shengjie, the court discretionarily adopts the assessment plan of the appearing expert witness, Liu Weijing, and determines the virtual treatment cost for Wang Shengjie's environmental pollution to be RMB 14,616.7.

Upon trial, it is found that since 2012, during the operation of his quartz stone processing plant, the defendant, Wang Shengjie, failed to apply for and obtain a *Pollutant Discharge Permit* from the environmental protection department. He purchased industrial waste hydrochloric acid to clean quartz stones and discharged over 100 tons of acid-containing wastewater generated during the pickling process through seepage pits into the Longbei Main Canal in Ganyu District, Lianyungang City, causing serious pollution to the Longbei Main Canal and the associated Lugou River, thereby harming the public interest. Subsequently, upon intervention by the local environmental protection department, the quartz plant ceased operations. Between June 26, 2013, and July 10, 2013, the former Ganyu County Environmental Monitoring Station conducted multiple environmental monitoring tests on the sewage and surface water in the area polluted by Wang Shengjie. The sewage at the defendant's drainage outlet and the Longbei Main Canal, as well as the polluted river water, had seriously exceeded the standards for pH value and fluoride, with the highest pH value exceeding the standard by 4.38 times and the highest fluoride exceeding the standard by 45.8 times. The water body into which the defendant discharged the pollution, the Longbei Main Canal, is part of the northward extension water diversion project of the Tongyu River and shall comply with Class III standards of the national surface water environmental quality standards. According to the recommended method for calculating the amount of environmental pollution damage in the *Several Opinions on Carrying out the Work of Environmental Pollution Damage Identification and Assessment* issued by the Ministry of Environmental Protection of the State, the principle for determining the remediation cost for Class III surface water pollution is 4.5 to 6 times the virtual treatment cost. Upon assessment, the virtual treatment cost for 100 tons of acidic wastewater with a concentration of 10% is approximately RMB 14,616.7.

The Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province, also finds that the plaintiff, Ganyu Environmental Protection Association, actually incurred lawyer fees of RMB 3,500 for initiating this public interest litigation.

Opinion of the Court (First Instance):

Pursuant to Article 29 of the *Water Pollution Prevention and Control Law*, it is prohibited to discharge oils, acid liquids, alkaline liquids, or highly toxic waste liquids into water bodies. Article 35 of the same Law provides that it is prohibited to use seepage wells, seepage pits, fissures, or karst caves to discharge or dump waste water containing toxic pollutants, sewage containing pathogens, or other wastes. The defendant, Wang Shengjie, without obtaining a *Pollutant Discharge Permit* from the competent environmental protection authority, illegally used acid washing to clean quartz stones and discharged the resulting acid-containing wastewater untreated through seepage pits, causing water pollution and affecting the ecological environment of the surrounding soil and other areas. He shall bear the liability for compensation for the environmental pollution damage he caused. The court supports the public interest litigation brought by the Ganyu District Environmental Protection Association and the support of the Lianyungang City People's Procuratorate in requesting the defendant to compensate for the damage to the public interest. According to the assessment opinion of the expert witness who appeared in court, the treatment cost for 100 tons of acid-containing wastewater is approximately RMB 14,616.7. As the wastewater was discharged untreated, resulting in increased treatment costs, it is impossible to specifically measure the degree of damage to the environment and ecology. Using the virtual cost treatment method in accordance with the recommended method for calculating the amount of environmental pollution damage in the *Several Opinions on Carrying out the Work of Environmental Pollution Damage Identification and Assessment* issued by the Ministry of Environmental Protection of the State is appropriate for this case. Considering factors such as the amount of waste acid discharged by Wang Shengjie and the environmental monitoring assessment opinion, the court discretionarily determines the environmental damage caused by the defendant to be RMB 75,000. Wang Shengjie claimed that his financial situation was very difficult and voluntarily offered to offset the environmental damage he caused by providing labor services beneficial to environmental protection in case his financial compensation capacity was insufficient. This is consistent with the environmental legislative principle of "whoever pollutes shall treat, whoever damages shall compensate" and is more conducive to environmental restoration and remediation than mere financial compensation. The court adopts this proposal. During the trial of this case, the Ganyu District Environmental Protection Bureau of Lianyungang City sent a letter agreeing to supervise the labor services provided by Wang Shengjie. With reference to the current national average daily wage standard for workers, the workload of the environmental protection labor services provided by Wang Shengjie shall be equivalent to the shortfall in his compensation for environmental pollution. The Ganyu Environmental Protection Association, as a non-profit public welfare organization, is entitled to have the reasonable expenses incurred for initiating this public interest litigation borne by the defendant. Pursuant to Article 41 of the *Environmental Protection Law of the People's Republic of China*, Article 85 of the *Water Pollution Prevention and Control Law of the People's Republic of China*, Articles 15 and 65 of the *Tort Law of the People's Republic of China*, and Articles 15, 55, and 148 of the *Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China*, the Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province, rendered the following judgment on September 9, 2014:

1. The defendant, Wang Shengjie, shall pay compensation of RMB 51,000 for the damage caused by environmental pollution. This amount shall be paid to the financial account designated by the Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province, within ten days after this judgment takes effect, to be used for ecological environment restoration and remediation.

2. The defendant, Wang Shengjie, shall provide a total of 960 hours of environmental public welfare labor (at least 6 times per month, each time no less than 6 hours) within two years after this judgment takes effect, to make up for the shortfall in his environmental compensation payment. The performance of this labor shall be supervised and managed by the Ganyu District Environmental Protection Bureau of Lianyungang City.

3. The defendant, Wang Shengjie, shall, within ten days after this judgment takes effect, pay the plaintiff, Ganyu District Environmental Protection Association, the expenses of RMB 3,500 incurred for initiating this public interest litigation.

After the judgment of first instance, neither party filed an appeal, and the judgment of first instance has become legally effective.
